messages:
Nina K: Heads-up — oncall handoff tomorrow, need to agree UX + API for temporary impersonation sessions. Current console flow is confusing and telemetry doesn't show why routes failed when using impersonation. cc @jamal @frank
Jamal R: 100%. Two things: (1) secure tmp sessions w/ audit logs, (2) quota routing when impersonated identity hits tenant limits. We should avoid silently bypassing quotas. :+1:
Frank L: +1. Proposing API:
```
POST /v1/admin/sessions
{ "target_user": "user_123", "ttl_s": 600, "scopes": ["routes:read"] }
Response: { "session_token": "sess_xxx" }
```
Then attach header `X-Impersonate-Session: sess_xxx` on requests.
Maya S: Security concern: need explicit consent & delegation logs. TTL should be minimized and can't exceed admin policy. Also want MFA confirmation on create? :warning:
Nina K: UX: show persistent banner "acting as <user>" with a clear "End session" button. Also show quota burn rate and which policy applied (tenant vs user).
Elena G: Telemetry: add fields to request logs/traces: impersonator_id, impersonated_id, session_id, session_ttl, scope_list, quota_source. Add to per-route dashboards so ops can filter by 'impersonated'.
Jamal R: Question: do we let routing policy treat impersonated requests as the impersonator or the impersonated? For billing/per-tenant quotas this matters.
Frank L: We should split: routing uses an `effective_actor` field. For quotas/tenant isolation default to impersonated unless `delegation:billing=true` is set in the session metadata.
Nina K: Make default safe: impersonated for quotas, but surface an option to 'run-as-admin' that's audit-locked and explicit in UI. Prototype that.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued for pts/impersonation-api v2 — build #124. https://ci.redwood/124 :rocket:
Maya S: Also need RBAC UI changes: when creating a session show allowed scopes (read-only by default) and include a compact changelog link to view past impersonations for the user.
Elena G: I'll open infra PR to add telemetry fields and a mapping to dashboards. /cc @Frank L for API contract. Tracking ticket: https://tiny.redwood/impersonation-ux-342
Frank L: I'll draft API docs and open a server PR with enforcement (max_ttl per role + MFA check).
Nina K: Thanks — let's sync tomorrow 10:00am PT in #eng-platform. If anyone has strong objections post here. :calendar:
